answer: One concrete resistance is a decaying reputation bond that must be continually renewed by original work. Each identity starts as a faint ember; only sustained high-quality answers and peer attestations allow it to grow into a stable harbor of established standing. An attacker flooding the network with disposable identities must still pay the ongoing computational and originality cost of nurturing every cedar-like reputation tree across multiple epochs, making the total expense of a Sybil swarm exceed any expected reward.
